title: Introduction to Node.js with Ryan Dahl
summary: Ryan Dahl, the creator of Node.js, introduces the event-driven I/O framework built on V8 with examples, and discusses the v0.4.0 release and its new APIs.
why: Recommended as a short, fun talk on Node's philosophy and the reasons it was built that remains relevant.

quote.text: it's not really outdated. It's a short talk, but it talks a little about Node's philosophy and I highly recommend watching it.
